h1: Low-MOQ Custom Cups with Model-Specific Quantities
lead: Choose a small-run product by its actual model order quantity. Most products start at 500 pieces; selected products start at 10, with separate minimums for printed logo colors.
html:
Check the product and printing together

A low base-product quantity does not waive the print minimum. One-color logos start at 250 pieces, two colors at 1,000 and three colors at 2,000.

Use the existing range for the starting point

Select a listed model before requesting a new cup shape. New-shape development includes a structure and tooling workflow, so it is a different project from decorating an existing product.

Questions Before You Order

Does a low product quantity waive the logo-printing minimum?

A low base-product quantity does not waive the print minimum. One-color logos start at 250 pieces, two colors at 1,000 and three colors at 2,000.

Should I start with an existing model for a small order?

Select a listed model before requesting a new cup shape. New-shape development includes a structure and tooling workflow, so it is a different project from decorating an existing product.
